    # (the original `start`). This happens when the original `end` is a weekday
    # and the original `start` is a weekend, so the loop runs at least once.

    start = date(2026, 10, 20)   # Saturday (weekend)
    end = date(2026, 10, 19)     # Friday (weekday) -> end < start is True
    # After swap: start becomes 2026-10-19 (Friday), end becomes 2026-10-20 (Saturday)
    # The while loop condition `current < end` will be evaluated with `current`
    # initially set to the swapped `start` (2026-10-19). Since 2026-10-19 < 2026-10-20,

    # Thus the else branch (the body of the if `not is_weekend(current)`) is taken.
    result = business_days_between(start, end)
    assert result == 1
